message.text: Landed on michael/dev and pushed. A Chat v3 prompt card no longer shows its own words twice ("Hello" as the title, then "Hello" again as the body) — the muted title is now dropped for short chit-chat with no refined text, while a real topic card keeps its title as before. Replies still nest on the card either way. See it live at /framework/ext/Chat/v3/.
